mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedules(user_id,enabled,run_time,days_of_week,timezone,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{enabled},#{runTime},#{daysOfWeek},#{timezone},#{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled=excluded.enabled,run_time=excluded.run_time, days_of_week=excluded.days_of_week,timezone=excluded.timezone,updated_at=excluded.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE schedules SET enabled=0,updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE user_id=#{userId}
ALTER TABLE schedules ADD COLUMN days_of_week TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1,2,3,4,5,6,7'
